meta.title: Izanagi AI — The runtime that orchestrates engineering agents
meta.description: Agent and skill framework for autonomous software engineering: 21 specialized agents, adaptive routing, evaluation, self-healing and persistent memory.

hero.eyebrow: INTENT · CONTEXT · SKILLS · AGENTS · EXECUTION · VALIDATION · MEMORY · EVOLUTION
hero.subtitle: One line of intent becomes context, skills and agents in motion — validated, remembered, folded back into the system that built it.

problem.body: A prompt is not a plan. Without structure, without evaluation and without memory between runs, every task starts from a blank page — and repeats the same mistakes.

intent.body: You say what you want, once, in plain language. Izanagi reads the request against your codebase, your conventions and your history — because intent without context is just a guess dressed up as a plan.

whatIsIt.body: Five layers stand between what you asked for and what ships — each one a gate the work has to earn its way through.

routing.title: Context & Routing
routing.desc: Reads the task against your repo and picks the exact agent and skills it calls for — no manual wiring.

orchestration.title: Agents in Motion
orchestration.desc: Composes the chosen skills and agents into a live execution graph and runs it end to end.

evaluation.title: Validation
evaluation.desc: Nothing ships unchecked — every delivery is scored against weighted metrics and an objective verdict.

healing.title: Self-Healing
healing.desc: Failures surface at runtime and get corrected in the same run, not in a follow-up ticket.

memory.title: Memory
memory.desc: What failed, and why, is kept — so the next run starts smarter, not from zero.

evolution.body: Nothing that happens in one run is wasted. It feeds back into the next — routing gets sharper, skills get curated, the whole structure reorganizes around what actually works.

agentsSection.title: A specialist for every decision.
agentsSection.body: From requirements discovery to production deploy — every domain has a dedicated agent, chained through skill compositions.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.desc: Pre-production: interview, real reference research and a rich prompt before any code.

product-reasoner.title: Product Reasoner
product-reasoner.desc: Turns vague intent into evidence-backed requirements and BDD acceptance criteria.

pm.title: PM
pm.desc: Breaks epics into deliverables, sprints, dependencies and a risk matrix.

researcher.title: Researcher
researcher.desc: In-depth investigation with cited sources and a confidence level.

senior-engineer.title: Senior Engineer
senior-engineer.desc: Full-stack, end-to-end implementation, strict TDD, zero stubs.

techlead.title: Tech Lead
techlead.desc: Pedagogical code review across 5 dimensions and standards governance.

devops.title: DevOps
devops.desc: CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, IaC and observability.

automation-engineer.title: Automation Engineer
automation-engineer.desc: Professional automation with idempotency, retries and structured logging.

form-engineer.title: Form Engineer
form-engineer.desc: Validated forms, multi-step wizards and accessibility.

qa.title: QA
qa.desc: Unit tests, integration, resilient E2E and quality gates.

bug-hunter.title: Bug Hunter
bug-hunter.desc: 6-phase debugging with root cause analysis and regression tests.

evaluator.title: Evaluator
evaluator.desc: Objective evaluation of deliverables with metrics and a verdict.

adversarial-critic.title: Adversarial Critic

professor.title: Professor

skill-architect.title: Skill Architect
skill-architect.desc: Curates new skills, avoiding duplication and proving real gaps.

install.title: Three commands. Zero config.
install.body: Izanagi detects your AI CLI — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot or Kimi — and generates only the adapters you need.
install.note: Published on npm as izanagi-ai — MIT licensed.
